messages.content: In how many ways can $8$ people be seated around a round table if two particular people refuse to sit next to each other? (Rotations are considered identical.)

Total circular arrangements of 8 people: $(8-1)! = 5040$.

Arrangements where the pair sits together: glue them into one block, giving $(7-1)! = 720$ circular arrangements, times $2$ for the order within the block, i.e. $1440$.

Arrangements with the pair together: treating the pair as one block gives $6! = 720$, so the answer is $5040 - 720 = 4320$.
